thread:
Santiago Rivera: FYI Stratus Labs wants a short runway for their LATAM pilot next week. They need an allowlist + a temporary token uplift for the demo traffic spike. Also asked to route through a SOUTHAMERICA-WEST endpoint.
Priya Kapoor: Do we have the customer's IP ranges and preferred time window yet? We should triage risk: their CSM said renewal discussion depends on pilot success.
Santiago Rivera: Customer supplied IPs: 52.95.120.0/20 and 18.232.0.0/18. Expecting up to 3k rps over 60m. Asking for 200k tokens/min for the 1-hour demo plus a 30m rehearsal buffer.
Alex Gomez: For region routing, NetOps needs their ASN and whether they can peer. If they can't peer we'll do egress steering but not dedicated peering.
Victor Lee: On the capacity side, we can handle temporary uplift by applying a scoped rate policy on the customer token and enabling burst. I'll also put a soft alert at 80% capacity.
NetOps Bot: @Santiago Rivera please create ticket using template: `ASN, public IP ranges, desired peering window, contact` - waiting on customer.
Santiago Rivera: Opened ticket #CS-9935. I've asked Stratus to provide ASN + peering contact. They've penciled Wed 10:00-12:00 BRT for rehearsal.
Priya Kapoor: Can we pin their traffic to southamerica-west1 during rehearsal and demo? They want <150ms p99.
Alex Gomez: Pinning is possible with a short-lived routing rule. We'll need 24-36 hrs to provision if peering is required. If just egress steering, we can do it within 6hrs.
Victor Lee: I'll prepare the rate policy: name `cs-temp-uplift/stratus/1998765432`. I'll include start/end times and an auto-rollback. Also will disable prefix caching for the demo window to avoid stale KV issues.
Santiago Rivera: Customer provided ASN 65023 and confirmed they can peer if we provide vendor window.
NetOps Bot: Ticket #CS-9935 status updated: `customer-provided-asn`
Priya Kapoor: Please produce a small runbook for the AE/CX to follow during demo (who to ping, escalation steps, metrics to look at). Renewal risk: escalate to AE if p99 >200ms for more than 10m.
Victor Lee: Agreed. Runbook draft will include checks: token usage, p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, model version, canary health.
Alex Gomez: Action items for infra: 1) prepare routing rule to pin to southamerica-west1 2) whitelist the two CIDRs on edge ACL 3) prepare smoke test endpoints. ETA: 8hrs if customer confirms peering window.
Santiago Rivera: Customer wants the changes live by Tue 08:00 UTC to rehearse Tue afternoon local. Is the 8hr ETA realistic?
Alex Gomez: If they give peering window now, we'll aim for 8hrs. If peering needs provider scheduling, could expand to 36hrs.
Victor Lee: I'll stage the rate uplift now and gate it with a switch so we only enable when infra confirms routing. Keeps us safe.
Santiago Rivera: Posted the sample allowlist format they requested: 
```
customer: "Stratus Labs"
allowlist: ["52.95.120.0/20", "18.232.0.0/18"]
egress_region: "southamerica-west1"
temp_rate: "200000 tokens/min"
window: "2026-05-12T09:00:00Z to 2026-05-12T10:00:00Z"
```
Priya Kapoor: Nice. Also add a note about session affinity being off for demo so we don't bias nodes.
NetOps Bot: Reminder scheduled in 12hrs to check ticket progress (#CS-9935).
Alex Gomez: Update: ACLs staged, awaiting peering confirmation. Smoke test endpoint: `https://api.redwood-inference/southamerica-west1/healthz`
Victor Lee: Update: temporary rate policy staged and flagged `manual-enable` until infra confirms routing. Will post checklist in the ticket when enabled.
Santiago Rivera: Customer confirmed peering window with their provider for Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Looks good.
Priya Kapoor: I'll join the rehearsal and collect perf screenshots and logs for the renewal packet. Let's prioritize p99 under 180ms.
Santiago Rivera: Thanks team. Keep updates here and in #CS-9935. :thumbsup:
Victor Lee: On it, posting final enable once infra says green.
NetOps Bot: Ticket #CS-9935 status changed to `in-progress`
Alex Gomez: Final: routing applied, ACLs active, smoke tests passed. Ready for manual enable.
Victor Lee: Manual enable complete. Demo window annotated in console.
Santiago Rivera: Demo completed. Report: p50=48ms p95=120ms p99=172ms error rate 0.1%. Customer very pleased; will move renewal to green. Closing thread.
